additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395278-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2/S6 313724839002] Authorization Issue CRM:00643001159
additional_info.body:
Hi Milan,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs again, and for the latest 1-day logs, we found that a successful charging session occurred on DC1 with the EV's state of charge (SOC) reaching up to 80%. In another charging session, authentication was not completed in a timely manner. Additionally, the charger was rebooted around 2:00 PM UTC on December 13th, at which point the connectors was unavailable. Throughout the past day, the connector was briefly unavailable for fractions of a second due to a CoAP polling issue caused by a lack of communication with the SECC. This issue has already been addressed with the concerned team and will be fixed in the upcoming firmware update.
Regarding the three points that you're seeing in the logs, ConnectorId : 0 is for the complete charger and ConnectorId 1&2 are for respected DC outlets.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
